name: Ollama
label: Ollama
description: Official Ollama native HTTP API on the customer host (INPUT llm_input → OUTPUT llm_output). Default base http://127.0.0.1:11434. operation selects chat (POST /api/chat), generate (POST /api/generate), embed (POST /api/embed), list_models (GET /api/tags), or pull (POST /api/pull). Optional api_key (Bearer) when the operator enabled auth; local loopback needs none. Dedicated node for native extras (list/pull/embed/generate) — not a replacement for shipped Local LLM chat. Customer-host only; do not point at ollama.com. Docs: https://docs.ollama.com/api/introduction. File/image use type file. Never log api_key.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: llm_input
ports.description: v2 LLM request / native Ollama fields. Shape: {messages, prompt?, input?, model?, tools?, stream?, file?}. Image sources use type file (platform ref-id). Do not put api_key here. Send stream=false so OfficialApiNode can parse a single JSON object.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT: chat | generate | embed | list_models | pull. Example: chat.

schema.label: messages
schema.description: Chat messages for operation=chat. List of {role, content}. Example: [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}].

schema.label: prompt
schema.description: Prompt for operation=generate (POST /api/generate). Required for generate.

schema.label: input
schema.description: String or string[] for operation=embed (POST /api/embed). Required for embed.

schema.label: model
schema.description: Local model name (e.g. llama3.1). Required for pull; required at runtime for chat/generate/embed. Overrides config when set.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Platform file ref-id for multimodal generate/chat images. Never inline bytes.

schema.label: inputFiles
schema.description: user-uploaded files and voice clips for the model

children.label: kind
children.description: File kind: image, document, audio, or video.

children.label: mime_type
children.description: RFC 1521 media type, e.g. application/pdf, image/png

children.label: source
children.description: How the payload is carried: base64 or url.

children.label: data
children.description: base64-encoded payload (when source=base64) or absolute URL (when source=url)

children.label: name
children.description: Original filename, surfaced as the upload name

schema.label: tools
schema.description: Request-body parameter `tools` for operation: chat.

schema.label: format
schema.description: Request-body parameter `format` for operations: chat, generate.

schema.label: options
schema.description: Request-body parameter `options` for operations: chat, generate, embed.

schema.label: think
schema.description: Request-body parameter `think` for operation: chat.

schema.label: keep_alive
schema.description: Request-body parameter `keep_alive` for operations: chat, generate, embed.

schema.label: suffix
schema.description: Request-body parameter `suffix` for operation: generate.

schema.label: images
schema.description: Request-body parameter `images` for operation: generate.

schema.label: system
schema.description: Request-body parameter `system` for operation: generate.

schema.label: raw
schema.description: Request-body parameter `raw` for operation: generate.

schema.label: truncate
schema.description: Request-body parameter `truncate` for operation: embed.

schema.label: insecure
schema.description: Request-body parameter `insecure` for operation: pull.

ports.name: llm_output
ports.description: v2 LLM response envelope. Success includes status/data from OfficialApiNode. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed Ollama JSON (chat message, generate response, embeddings, tags list, or pull status).

schema.label: result
schema.description: canonical assistant payload {role,content,tool_calls?,output_files?,…}

schema.label: outputFiles
schema.description: files produced by the model, e.g. generated images/audio

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official Ollama native verb. EXACT values: chat | generate | embed | list_models | pull. Default chat = POST /api/chat.

configurationParameters.label: Base URL
configurationParameters.description: Customer-host Ollama origin, no path suffix. Default http://127.0.0.1:11434. Interpolated as api_spec baseUrl. Do not use https://ollama.com (cloud is out of scope).

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: Optional Bearer token if the operator enabled Ollama API auth. Local 127.0.0.1:11434 needs none. Sent as Authorization: Bearer when set; omitted when blank. StudioQuack secret. Never logged. Never on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Model
configurationParameters.description: Local model name already pulled (or to pull). Example llama3.1. Also send on llm_input so OfficialApiNode includes it in the JSON body.

configurationParameters.label: Messages
configurationParameters.description: Chat messages for operation=chat. List of {role, content}. Example: [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}].

configurationParameters.label: Format
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `format` for operations: chat, generate.

configurationParameters.label: Think
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `think` for operation: chat.

configurationParameters.label: Options
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `options` for operations: chat, generate, embed.

configurationParameters.label: Tools
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `tools` for operation: chat.

configurationParameters.label: Keep Alive
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `keep_alive` for operations: chat, generate, embed.

configurationParameters.label: Raw
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `raw` for operation: generate.

configurationParameters.label: Suffix
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `suffix` for operation: generate.

configurationParameters.label: System
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `system` for operation: generate.

configurationParameters.label: Images
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `images` for operation: generate.

configurationParameters.label: Prompt
configurationParameters.description: Prompt for operation=generate (POST /api/generate). Required for generate.

configurationParameters.label: Input
configurationParameters.description: String or string[] for operation=embed (POST /api/embed). Required for embed.

configurationParameters.label: Truncate
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `truncate` for operation: embed.

configurationParameters.label: Insecure
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `insecure` for operation: pull.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: HTTP timeout. Default 300. Raise for pull of large weights. Floor 1.

configurationParameters.label: Stream
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: controls whether Ollama requests a streamed completion and fans live deltas through helper emitPartial. Canonical flag. When true the node POSTs stream:true, parses SSE data: lines, emitPartial("thinking", delta) for reasoning/thinking and emitPartial("answer", delta) for content; thoughts also appear on llm_output.result.thoughts / thinking; finish_reason, usage and tool_calls are assembled at the end. Accepted: select true | false. Default: true. Invalid/blank → true. Example: true.
